findings.claim: L2 pre-push and L3 reconcile can still be authorized by gitignored mirror envelopes.
findings.analysis: SOL-E001's Stop/verify/final-report and note-merge legs are closed: NOTE_REQUIRED_CONSUMERS rejects non-note sources for those consumers, and writeNote no longer Object.assigns mirror siblings into notes. The original proposed_fix also named push and reconcile. Those callers still invoke check-chain-receipts without --consumer, so getReceiptsForSha's documented development-mode mirror fallback remains live. A complete forged .svc/receipts/<sha>/ tree with no refs/notes/svc-receipts can therefore pass pre-push in refuse mode and reconcile responsibility A, which is the WI-542 class of shipping commits whose durable notes never existed.

findings.claim: Continuation children still fail open when the ledger is absent or not found, not only when JSON.parse throws.
findings.analysis: The SOL-E005 catch now fail-closes identified children (SVC_CONTINUATION_TOKEN or session id prefix svc-continuation-). isPhaseForbiddenForSession does not throw for a missing .svc/continuation dir, a cwd that does not contain the parent ledger, or no matching launched baton: it returns forbidden:false and the hook exits 0 before the looksLikeChild branch. A child that inherited the continuation token can then invoke diagnose-bug/plan-changeset/execute-changeset, violating AC-552-4. Fail-closed must apply to identified children whenever the launched baton cannot be validated, not only on thrown parse errors.

findings.claim: A work overlay without scope.wi still applies to every WI.
findings.analysis: SOL-E008 is fixed for the scoped-without-caller-WI case (refused). parseOverlay still applies any overlay that omits scope.wi globally, so SVC_DISPATCH_WORK_OVERLAY can remap another workflow. AC-551-4 requires work overlays not to leak across WIs; Sol's proposed_fix also required explicit scope. Unscoped overlays remain a leak vector.

findings.claim: Grok still declares fresh_session_launch.enabled=true with launch_command=null; WI-546 live proof is grok -p, not the controller spawn path.
findings.analysis: SOL-E003 is correctly fail-closed: non-fake launch with a null command records launch_blocked/capability_limited and never launch_receipted with pid=null (covered by validate-continuation-lifecycle-wi552). That makes the host declaration honest, not a ghost success. AC-546-3 / AC-552-10 still asked WI-546 to exercise a live Grok controller launch when the host declares the primitive. The live fixture only runs observational grok -p and skips if grok is missing, so restart-continuation parity is still capability-limited rather than proven.

findings.claim: Owner example policy names Cursor as the Sol/Fable review host, but run-external-review has no cursor/grok transport.
findings.analysis: SOL-E002 is closed as specified: REVIEW_HOST_TRANSPORTS is {codex,agy,claude}; unknown hosts including cursor/grok take the capability branch and never the old else-to-Claude argv. That is correct no-remap behavior. The shipped example dispatch policy still marks fable and sol-high as required independent stations with host=cursor, so a production review-exec that consumes that example through the launcher will capability-limit the required different-family stations instead of invoking cursor-agent. This station itself is Cursor Models inline-self, not that launcher path.

findings.claim: Session-override receipt session_id is not bound unless the caller already has a session id.
findings.analysis: SOL-E007's CRITICAL inline-JSON forge is closed: receipts must be a uid-owned non-world-writable non-symlink file, bind override_sha256, require WI, issued_at, and expires_at. Independently verifiable owner authorization is the same filesystem bar as ~/.svc/dispatch-policy.json, which is acceptable for this trust model. Residual: if (sessionId && receipt.session_id !== sessionId) lets a valid receipt file apply when SVC_SESSION_ID is unset.
